evidence_kind: Matching PE/PDB static instruction and jump-table evidence; no original-engine execution.

arguments.conversion: lua_isstring/lua_tolstring accepts actual strings and numeric carriers; absent/wrong types use default.

return.behavior: Return GetTextData(Text) != nullptr. No DisplayName field or string-length test occurs. Known records with empty, ambiguous or unadmitted DisplayName still return true.
return.lookup: GetTextData immediately returns null for null/empty key; source byte-wise hash and strcmp-equivalent lookup are case-sensitive.

representation.policy: All Id records from original English TextData files, including MacroText, and English aliases, independent of field admission/ambiguity. Numeric field carriers remain unsupported rather than guessed strings.
representation.old_catalog: HasDisplayName fails explicitly when complete membership is unavailable; no field-map inference.
representation.loader: ReadTextData0x1800b5690 enumerates sorted *.sjson language files (0xb5787..0xb57a7), calls the same per-file TextData loader at0xb5944. There is no MacroText filename exclusion.
representation.field_defaults: TextData ctor0x1800e95ec..0x1800e9627 initializes DisplayName+0x58, Description+0x70, AdditionalDescription+0x88 as empty strings. Absent fields export empty strings; ambiguous/unsupported fields remain explicit unknowns.

verification_limits: No runtime build/replay/device check in this static evidence record.
Existing English localization scope retained; no inference about other languages.
Numeric string-field conversion remains unrecovered; only record membership and other admitted fields are known for those rows.
